scope: DEV diagnostic only; non-newcomer races only; no validation/OOS opened
core_finding: Both v4 and v5 systematically move probability mass away from market rank 1 and rank 7+ horses toward market ranks 2-6. This creates a structural dependency on which market-rank band contains the eventual winner and may contribute to month-to-month instability.

winner_rank_diagnostic_post_outcome.warning: Uses eventual winner rank and is therefore diagnosis-only; forbidden for race selection, betting, or promotion.

market_uncertainty_diagnostic.interpretation: The most diffuse-market quartile is negative on average for both models, but confidence intervals cross zero. Treat as a forward-test weakness hypothesis, not a filter.

next_research_hypothesis.name: uncertainty-adaptive shrinkage toward market
next_research_hypothesis.idea: When pre-race market uncertainty is high, reduce the magnitude of candidate-model probability redistribution instead of applying the same correction strength across all races.
guardrails: Do not use eventual winner rank as an input.
Do not tune thresholds on validation/OOS.
Do not execute a new DEV trial until Race-time Snapshot Gate v4 real forward provenance passes and a new prereg is externally anchored.
Until then, use only shadow diagnostic tags in forward operation.
